```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 6)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath(".."))
```

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(viridis)
library(RColorBrewer)

source("R/utils.R")
```

# Load Results

```{r load}
region_table <- read_csv("results/tables/all_regions.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
event_table <- read_csv("results/tables/all_events.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
patient_summaries <- read_csv("results/tables/patient_summaries.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

long_features <- tryCatch(
  read_csv("results/tables/longitudinal_features.csv", show_col_types = FALSE),
  error = function(e) tibble()
)
```

# 1. Patient Volume Timeline

```{r volume_timeline}
top_patients <- patient_summaries %>%
  arrange(desc(total_events)) %>%
  head(6) %>%
  pull(patient_id)

if (length(top_patients) > 0) {
  region_table %>%
    filter(patient_id %in% top_patients) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = timepoint, y = volume_cm3, color = region_type, group = region_id)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    facet_wrap(~patient_id, scales = "free") +
    labs(title = "Region Volume Over Time",
         x = "Timepoint", y = "Volume (cm³)", color = "Region Type") +
    scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

  ggsave("results/figures/volume_timeline.png", width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 150)
}
```

# 2. Event Distribution

```{r events, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
if (nrow(event_table) > 0) {
  event_counts <- event_table %>%
    count(event_type) %>%
    mutate(event_type = fct_reorder(event_type, n, .desc = TRUE))

  ggplot(event_counts, aes(event_type, n, fill = event_type)) +
    geom_col() +
    geom_text(aes(label = n), vjust = -0.5) +
    labs(title = "Distribution of Progression Events",
         x = "Event Type", y = "Count") +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

  ggsave("results/figures/event_distribution.png", width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 150)
}
```

# 3. Volume Change Distribution

```{r vol_change, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
if (nrow(long_features) > 0) {
  p1 <- ggplot(long_features, aes(pct_volume_change)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "#2563eb", alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-0.25, 0.25), linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
    labs(title = "% Volume Change Distribution",
         x = "% Change", y = "Count") +
    theme_minimal()

  p2 <- ggplot(long_features, aes(centroid_displacement)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "#16a34a", alpha = 0.7) +
    labs(title = "Centroid Displacement Distribution",
         x = "Displacement (mm)", y = "Count") +
    theme_minimal()

  p1 + p2
  ggsave("results/figures/feature_distributions.png", width = 10, height = 5, dpi = 150)
}
```

# 4. Patient Summary Heatmap

```{r heatmap, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
if (nrow(patient_summaries) > 5) {
  summary_long <- patient_summaries %>%
    select(patient_id, n_growing_regions, n_shrinking_regions,
           n_appearances, n_disappearances, n_splits, n_merges) %>%
    pivot_longer(-patient_id, names_to = "feature", values_to = "value") %>%
    mutate(feature = str_replace_all(feature, "n_|_regions", "") %>%
             str_replace_all("_", " ") %>% str_to_title())

  ggplot(summary_long, aes(feature, patient_id, fill = value)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white") +
    scale_fill_viridis_c() +
    labs(title = "Patient Event Heatmap",
         x = "Feature", y = "Patient", fill = "Count") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

  ggsave("results/figures/patient_heatmap.png", width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 150)
}
```

# 5. Total Volume vs Region-Wise Insight

```{r insight, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
if (nrow(patient_summaries) > 0) {
  insight <- patient_summaries %>%
    mutate(
      total_says = case_when(
        total_vol_pct_change > 0.25 ~ "Growing",
        total_vol_pct_change < -0.25 ~ "Shrinking",
        TRUE ~ "Stable"
      ),
      regions_say = case_when(
        n_growing_regions > 0 & n_shrinking_regions > 0 ~ "Mixed (Hidden!)",
        n_growing_regions > 0 ~ "Growing",
        n_shrinking_regions > 0 ~ "Shrinking",
        TRUE ~ "Stable"
      )
    )

  mixed <- insight %>% filter(total_says != regions_say)
  cat("Patients where total volume DISAGREES with region-wise analysis:", nrow(mixed), "\n")

  ggplot(insight, aes(total_says, fill = regions_say)) +
    geom_bar(position = "dodge") +
    labs(title = "Total Volume vs Region-Wise Assessment",
         subtitle = paste(nrow(mixed), "patients show hidden regional changes"),
         x = "Total Volume Assessment", y = "Count",
         fill = "Region-Wise\nAssessment") +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
    theme_minimal()

  ggsave("results/figures/total_vs_regional.png", width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 150)
}
```

# 6. Region Type Volume Comparison

```{r region_types, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
if (nrow(region_table) > 0) {
  ggplot(region_table, aes(region_type, volume_cm3, fill = region_type)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
    labs(title = "Volume Distribution by Region Type",
         x = "Region Type", y = "Volume (cm³)") +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

  ggsave("results/figures/region_type_volumes.png", width = 10, height = 5, dpi = 150)
}
```
